subtitle: Adversarial science digests — a thesis defended and attacked to a verdict, every claim backed by computation.

disputes.title: The Yardstick That Shrank
disputes.subtitle: Does a method that compresses data to gain power secretly confirm too-simple theories — or does it just depend on where you measure the bar?
disputes.verdict: Aramis wins: the strong thesis fails — under an honest full-space noise ceiling the false-confirmation rate is 0% at every rank; the apparent inflation was an artifact of estimating the ceiling in the compressed space.

disputes.title: Two Choirs in the Dark
disputes.subtitle: Can a shared external signal be told from weak mutual coupling by passive observation alone?
